steps.text:
**Applying motif testing**

I'm thinking about applying a motif centered around the values [7,7,5,7,5]. I want to place it at each of the scattered points marked as 6. The goal here is to preserve the object and place patterns for all sixes, potentially removing any color marker dots. I realize I need to produce a program and run some tests to see how this all works out. Let's get to it!

from pathlib import Path
p=Path('programs/task-8a9c62cd.py')
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):\n    g=[row[:] for row in grid]\n    bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x:sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))\n    # Locate the five-cell template: the unique contiguous horizontal run not equal to background.\n    runs=[]\n    for r,row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c in range(len(row)-4):\n            if all(v!=bg for v in row[c:c+5]): runs.append((r,c,row[c:c+5]))\n    # Choose the run with five non-background cells (the source motif).\n    sr,sc,motif=runs[0]\n    # Every singleton of the distinct marker color is a placement center; template itself stays.\n    marker=next(v for v in set(x for row in grid for x in row) if v not in (bg,) and v not in motif)\n    for r,row in enumerate(grid):\n        for c,v in enumerate(row):\n            if v==marker:\n                for j,x in enumerate(motif):\n                    if 0<=c-2+j<len(row): g[r][c-2+j]=x\n    return g\n''')
PY
